d: Grizzy builds a look-alike robot to keep the Lemmings away while he prepares a party for his beloved she-bear. But his double's artificial intelligence leaves a lot to be desired.
Grizzy's she-bear is convinced she's a lemming after hitting her head. Grizzy believes another well-aimed hit will correct her thinking, but the Lemmings are thrilled to have a new playmate.
When a meteorite falls not far from the log cabin, strange berries start to grow. One of their properties is that they make anyone who eats them grow to disproportionate sizes.
Under the wood floor of the log cabin, Grizzy and the Lemmings discover the entrance to an underground gallery with an old treasure card that indicates the location of a treasure.

st: In the Service of His Majesty
d: When he brandishes an Indian sceptre that the Lemmings brought home with other antique objects, Grizzy sees the Lemmings bow low before him and behave like servants.

Grizzy tries to impress the she-bear that he's in love with by making a sculpture of her from a piece of wood. But as soon as the artist's back is turned, the Lemmings gnaw at the work of art in order to transform it into a toboggan slide.

The Lemmings throw a surprise birthday party for one of the clan. When Happy Birthday rings out, the surprise is as great for Grizzly, who is trying to have a nap after a hearty meal, as it is for the birthday Lemming hero in question.
A gust of wind sweeps away the flower that Grizzly's adored she-bear wears in her hair. Grizzly sees this as a golden opportunity to dazzle her by bringing it back.

Grizzy finds two identical vases that are actually communicating vessels in a Native American Indian chest. If he sticks his hand in one, it comes out the other, regardless of the distance between them.
Grizzy finds a vintage stopwatch in the garage which lets one wind back the minute that has just passed by, and it can even stop time and movement in one's surroundings.
Grizzy is disturbed in the middle of his TV snack by a flow of incongruous objects that have been transformed into hot-air balloons.
Grizzy discovers with great delight that the ranger has purchased a brand new multi-function Stressless recliner. But the Lemmings transform it into a fearsome multi-game chair.

st: Say Hello to My Little Friends
d: After telling the kids he will not miss them over a long weekend, Chef locks himself into the school and finds out he was very, very wrong.
The hottest day of the year and a broke air conditioner leads to a water battle of epic proportions to determine who controls the garden hose.
Cody is set to inherit a video game empire from his long-lost uncle, but only if he and his friends have what it takes to conquer a fantastical live action video game.
When the city experiences a toilet paper shortage Beth and Harold investigate and discover it's their old rival Sewer Mike who is the mastermind behind it all.
Harold uncovers a secret plot that Chef's new parrot is hatching and tries to save his teacher only to discover that Sugar figured it out before him. Or did she?

When rain derails an outside game of catch someone suggests they play it inside. This prompts Izzy to lead the group through her wildly imaginative worst case scenario. It's an adventure so scary that the kids many never play again.
After Owen's BBF, Noah, goes through a growth spurt, Owen fears losing his friend and takes drastic action.
When the floor ends up covered in gum on the day of a big bubble blowing contest, Sugar decides she might help herself win by helping her friends get stuck to the floor.
When all their classmates are replaced with well-behaved Australian doppelgängers in a school exchange programme, Lightning and Cody start getting suspicious.
Gwen orders a personality modifying ray to tone her perky parents but decides to test it on the class first.
When Beth, Duncan and Izzy break Chef's new VR helmet they have to recreate his game world to keep him from ever finding out the truth.
When a lack of motivation threatens to sink the kids' chances in the Sportslete Athlaction Awards, they create the greatest mascot of all time to boost school spirit.
When Cody gets sick, the kids want to send a message back to his home planet in hopes that they can save him, but Courtney is not in favour of this plan.
When an evil conglomerate is threatening to takeover Chef's favourite childhood restaurant, Owen rallies the kids to take them down.
Chef brings a souvenir iceberg home from a trip to the South Pole and Duncan finds a prehistoric surprise inside.
When Chef discovers his spooky Halloween pranks have never scared the kids, he is completely devastated, and agrees to hand over full control of his pranking responsibilities to Gwen.

When Chef discovers that his Halloween pranks have never frightened the children, he decides to go on the counterattack by asking for Gwen's help. But this plan will bring him more scares than he intended.
The Bad Guy Busters must reunite to save Izzy after Harold uncovers her previous identity and leads a super villain from her past right to her.

Chef forgets the password for his computer but knows it has something to do with one of the 99 previous explosions that took out the school. Entering the wrong password will cause the school to blow up for the 100th time.
After Courtney refuses to share her taffy winnings from a calculus for candy competition, she's transported to the desolate future where she learns that greed is not without consequence.
After eating the snacks meant for everyone and replacing them with disgusting low budget cookies from Barfvomita, Owen is full of guilt (and cookies) and tries to make things right.

st: Not for the Paint of Heart
d: When Izzy believes that Chef wants her to Rise to the Challenge of destroying the daycare with art, she gets some magic paint to bring all her creations to life.
After believing he's turned Chef to stone, Duncan sets his sights on ultimate chaos, only to discover there's no joy in victory without an adversary.

st: An Unexpectedly Hard Fight?! Vegeta's Explosion of Rage!
d: Magetta starts a heat wave, causing Vegeta to broil inside the ring's barrier, but the Saiyan manages to unleash his full power against his opponent.

st: Don't Forget Your Saiyan Pride! Vegeta vs. the 6th Universe's Saiyan!
d: Vegeta demands that Cabba transform into a Super Saiyan during their battle, but when Cabba cannot, Vegeta reverts to his old, malicious ways and threatens to kill him.

st: Universe 6's Most Powerful Warrior! Meet Hit Man Hit!!
d: Vegeta meets his match as he battles the last fighter from Universe 6, the assassin Hit, who possesses an incredibly rare skill that may spell doom for the 7th universe team.

st: Great Time-Skipping Counterattack?! Is It Coming? Goku's New Technique!
d: Faced with a critical loss, Goku must figure out a way to defeat Hit after the assassin improves his time skip ability during their battle.

st: Conclusion At Last! Is Beerus The Winner? Or Is It Shanpa?
d: As the fighters continue giving their all against one another, Goku and Hit's fight comes to a sudden conclusion; the puny Monaka becomes Universe 7's last hope of victory.

st: Come, God of Dragons - And Pretty Please Grant My Wish!
d: The Universal Tournament ends and Universe Seven emerge as the winners, with Monaka as the sole survivor. Champa and Beerus witness the coming of the King of All, Zeno, the Omni-King.

st: Trouble at the Victory Celebration! Showdown at Last?! Monaka vs. Son Goku!
d: Bulma throws a party to celebrate winning the martial arts tournament and invites both Beerus and Monaka. Soon after, Goku spots Monaka and challenges him to a fight.

Shun and Lightning volunteer to brawl in the fourth Battle Judgement match taking place in downtown Los Volmos while Dan and Lia protect the city's residents from the Swarm's attack.
Dan and Drago must save the day when an old enemy threatens to plunge Los Volmos into crisis.
In the fifth Battle Judgement match, Dan and Drago face off against Tripp and Tiko in a Darkavian cave.
Wearing a special device Athena and Wynton built, Buzzy attempts to return the energy to the Yucatán Peninsula without Hanoj finding out.
The Awesome Brawlers travel back to Auropolis for the sixth Battle Judgment match and take care of some unfinished business.
Lightning is summoned to space in order to represent all of dog-kind in an age-old feud.
The laws of physics are challenged in the seventh Battle Judgement match, with Haora's floating islands setting the stage.
The Awesome Brawlers are surprised by Hanoj during the course of the eighth and final Battle Judgement match.
